title: the frozen plan, step and option contract of the api freeze
description: freezes the plan, the step and the option grammar shapes: the plan carries its objective, origin and reviewed steps while every step carries its id, its frozen action kind, its target, value and reviewed json options; the review surface documents the approve and reject decisions with the plan states and no hard cap on the step count, because the plan grammar bounds nothing the review did not bound.

origin.description: the exact origin the plan runs inside

steps.description: the reviewed steps in execution order with no hard cap on the count

createdat.description: the epoch milliseconds the plan was created

expiresat.description: the epoch milliseconds the plan expires

state.description: the plan state of the frozen review surface

approvedat.description: the epoch milliseconds the human approved the plan

completedat.description: the epoch milliseconds the plan completed

kind.description: the frozen action kind identifier of the immutable vocabulary

target.description: the reviewed css selector the step addresses

value.description: the reviewed literal value the step carries

options.description: the reviewed json options of the option grammar

summary.description: the human readable summary the review reads

idempotencykey.description: the deterministic key replays deduplicate on

environment.description: the execution environment the step names

agentid.description: the fleet agent the step attributes to

intenthint.description: the plain language navigation intent label

options.description: the frozen option grammar field families of the reviewed step options

targetref.description: the reviewed element reference the page bridge resolves

modifiers.description: the reviewed key modifiers of key steps

pipeline.description: the extractpipeline reference of the extract steps

pollrequest.description: the longpoll request grammar of a transport step

graphql.description: the graphql subscription grammar of a channel step

correlation.description: the per run request correlation map

ocr.description: the flag that runs recognition on the stored capture bytes

vision.description: the reviewed vision prompt block of a capture step

ocrregion.description: the region grammar of a regionocr reading

pair.description: the beforeafter capture mode around a step

diff.description: the flag that runs the diffshot comparison after a sensitive step

snapshot.description: the session snapshot plan of a capturesession step

reviewsurface.description: the frozen review surface of the plan: the human approves or rejects a pending plan, the approve and reject runtime messages travel the background surface, and the review carries no hard cap on the step count, the expiry window or the option grammar depth because every bound the review honors stays a user choice
